title: Dukkham
text: 3 Dukkham dukkhanti āvuso Sāriputta vuccati || katamaṃ nu kho āvuso dukkhanti || || Tisso imāvuso dukkhatā || dukkhadukkhatā saṅkhāradukkhatā vipariṇāmadukkhatā || imā kho avuso dukkhatā ti || || 4 Atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etāsaṃ dukkhatānam pariññāyāti || || Atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etāsaṃ dukkhatānam pariññāyāti || || 5 Katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etāsaṃ dukkhatānam pariññāyāti || || Ayam eva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etāsaṃ dukkhatānam pariññāya || seyyathīdaṃ sammādiṭṭhi || pe || sammāsamādhi || ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayam paṭipadā etāsam dukkhatānam pariññāyāti || || 6 Bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etāsam dukkhatānam pariññāya || alañca panāvuso Sāriputta appamādāyāti || ||
